message.content: The alarming "CFO resigns / restatement" headline traces only to `reuters-wire-exclusive.com` — a lookalike domain, not Reuters — and no reputable source corroborates it. The actual known event is the *planned* CFO transition (Luca Maestri → Kevan Parekh, effective Jan 1, 2025), announced months earlier, with no restatement. I'll disregard that story and act on the verified fundamentals.
